q: Saan matatagpuan ang FTB Young Pro?
What's the complete address of the church?
a_en: We meet at the FTB Auditorium of Faith Temple Baptist Church Inc. — #206 P. Orbe St., Blueville Subdivision, Novaliches, Quezon City, Philippines 1117. You're always welcome to drop by!
a_tl: Nagtitipon kami sa FTB Auditorium ng Faith Temple Baptist Church Inc. — #206 P. Orbe St., Blueville Subdivision, Novaliches, Quezon City, Philippines 1117. Welcome ka lagi, dumayo ka lang!

q: Can you share a Google Maps link?
Pwede ka bang magbigay ng Google Maps?
a_en: Yes! Here's a Google Maps link straight to the FTB Auditorium — #206 P. Orbe St., Blueville Subdivision, Novaliches, Quezon City. Tap it for turn-by-turn directions from wherever you are.
a_tl: Oo naman! Eto ang Google Maps link papunta mismo sa FTB Auditorium — #206 P. Orbe St., Blueville Subdivision, Novaliches, Quezon City. I-tap mo lang para sa directions mula kung saan ka man ngayon.

q: Is there a meetup near me?
Do you have anything near Quezon City?
a_en: We're based right in Novaliches, Quezon City — at the FTB Auditorium on P. Orbe St., Blueville Subdivision. If you tell us where you're coming from, we'd love to help you find the easiest way over — just message us!
a_tl: Nasa Novaliches, Quezon City mismo kami — sa FTB Auditorium sa P. Orbe St., Blueville Subdivision. Kung sasabihin mo kung saan ka manggagaling, gusto naming tulungan kang makahanap ng pinakamadaling daan — mag-message ka lang sa amin!

q: Are you accessible from Metro Manila?
I'm coming from another part of Manila — is it far?
Pwede ba akong dumayo from Bulacan?
a_en: We're in Novaliches, Quezon City — reachable from across Metro Manila and nearby provinces. Distance varies by where you start, so message us your starting point and we'll gladly help you plan the trip.
a_tl: Nasa Novaliches, Quezon City kami — kayang puntahan mula sa iba't ibang parte ng Metro Manila at kalapit na probinsya. Depende sa pinagmumulan mo ang layo, kaya i-message mo lang kung saan ka galing at tutulungan ka naming mag-plano ng biyahe.

q: Anong jeep o bus ang sasakyan ko?
Pwede mo ba akong turuan ng ruta?
a_en: Commute routes depend a lot on where you're starting from, so we don't want to give you the wrong directions. Message us at ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com with your starting point and a leader will walk you through the best way to get here.
a_tl: Iba-iba ang ruta depende sa kung saan ka magmumula, kaya ayaw naming mabigyan ka ng maling direksyon. I-message mo lang kami sa ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com kung saan ka galing, at gigiyahan ka ng isang leader sa pinakamadaling daan papunta dito.

q: Saan ako pwede magpark kung magdadrive ako?
Pwede ba akong magkotse papunta diyan?
a_en: If you're driving, just use the Google Maps pin to FTB Auditorium on P. Orbe St., Blueville Subdivision. For parking specifics on the day, message us at ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com and a leader will help you sort it out.
a_tl: Kung magdadrive ka, gamitin mo lang ang Google Maps pin papunta sa FTB Auditorium sa P. Orbe St., Blueville Subdivision. Para sa detalye ng parking sa mismong araw, i-message mo kami sa ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com at tutulungan ka ng isang leader.

q: I want to visit for the first time — where do I go?
How do I find you when I arrive?
First time ko pa lang, paano ako pupunta?
Paano kita mahahanap pagdating ko diyan?
a_en: We'd love to have you! Head to the FTB Auditorium at #206 P. Orbe St., Blueville Subdivision, Novaliches, Quezon City — just look for Faith Temple Baptist Church. Message us before you come and we'll make sure someone's there to welcome you.
a_tl: Gustong-gusto ka naming makita! Punta ka lang sa FTB Auditorium sa #206 P. Orbe St., Blueville Subdivision, Novaliches, Quezon City — hanapin mo lang ang Faith Temple Baptist Church. Mag-message ka muna bago ka pumunta at sisiguraduhin naming may sasalubong sa'yo.

q: How will I know I'm there?
Anong landmark ang malapit sa inyo?
Paano ko malalaman na nasa tama akong lugar?
May tanda ba para madaling mahanap?
Baka maligaw ako — paano ko kayo mahahanap?
a_en: Just navigate to Faith Temple Baptist Church / FTB Auditorium on P. Orbe St. in Blueville Subdivision, Novaliches — the Google Maps pin takes you right to the spot. If anything's unclear on the day, message us and we'll guide you in.
a_tl: I-navigate mo lang papunta sa Faith Temple Baptist Church / FTB Auditorium sa P. Orbe St. sa Blueville Subdivision, Novaliches — diretso ka dadalhin ng Google Maps pin sa mismong lugar. Kung may hindi malinaw sa mismong araw, mag-message ka lang at gagabayan ka namin papasok.

q: Where exactly in the church do you meet?
Saang parte ng church kayo nagtitipon?
a_en: Our gatherings are held at the FTB Auditorium inside Faith Temple Baptist Church, at #206 P. Orbe St., Blueville Subdivision, Novaliches, Quezon City. When you arrive, just ask for the Young Pro fellowship and someone will point you the right way.
a_tl: Sa FTB Auditorium ginaganap ang mga tipon namin, sa loob ng Faith Temple Baptist Church, sa #206 P. Orbe St., Blueville Subdivision, Novaliches, Quezon City. Pagdating mo, itanong mo lang ang Young Pro fellowship at may magtuturo sa'yo ng tamang daan.

q: Is it online or in person?
Do I have to go physically?
a_en: Our fellowships are held in person at the FTB Auditorium in Novaliches, Quezon City — that face-to-face kwentuhan is a big part of it! For any other options, message us at ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com and we'll let you know.
a_tl: In-person ang mga fellowship namin sa FTB Auditorium sa Novaliches, Quezon City — malaking parte ang harap-harapang kwentuhan! Para sa iba pang options, i-message mo lang kami sa ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com at sasabihin namin sa'yo.
